pager-duty-bot: INC-2026: High 5xx rate detected on /v1/generate — paging eng-oncall (P2)

Elaine M.: on it, I'm seeing a sudden jump in 5xx errors starting ~3m ago. dashboards show overall 5xx rate at ~4.8% cluster-wide.

Samir P.: any deploys in the last 10m?

Elaine M.: nope, no deploys from us. infra-bot indicates a spike in upstream gateway timeouts to model-hosting-eu (502/504).

infra-bot: Correlation: increased 504s to model-hosting-eu.backend.cluster -> 10.22.18.5:443; request latency to upstream increased from ~80ms to ~1.2s.

Ryan K.: can we confirm customer impact? which routes are affected?

Elaine M.: primary impact on hosted text-generation (/v1/generate) and chat streaming. I've pulled the recent error samples — most are gateway timeouts and 502s returned by our gateway when upstream closes connection.

Elaine M.: quick mitigation plan: 1) fail traffic to the fallback model variant for non-enterprise customers, 2) increase circuit-breaker timeout to 6s for gateway->upstream, 3) mute noisy 1m 5xx alerts while we stabilize.

Kate L.: +1 on fallback. We should avoid muting alerts entirely; mute the 1m noisy alert and keep the 5m aggregation alert live.

Samir P.: I'm going to apply a temporary route policy so 60% of traffic goes to fallback variant (redwood-llama-13b-fallback) and 40% continues to primary. Command: `ops route set --service /v1/generate --split primary:40,fallback:60 --reason "upstream degradation"`

Elaine M.: executing now.

Elaine M.: done. traffic split updated. I'm seeing a drop in 5xx to ~1.6% after split — still above normal but much better.

Ryan K.: good. I'll touch the alerting: current 5xx-rate alert is firing on rate >0.5% over 1m — that's causing jitter. Propose changing to rate >2% over 5m for the global 5xx page, and keep a separate critical alert for sustained >5% over 5m. Thoughts?

Kate L.: sounds reasonable. Also add a one-off anomaly detector for sudden spike >200% from baseline in 2m window so we catch fast regressions without churn.

Samir P.: +1. Also, create a dashboard tile showing upstream 502/504 counts per upstream host so we can quickly isolate provider-level issues.

Elaine M.: I'm creating the follow-ups: Ops ticket: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/OPS-1248 "Tune 5xx alerts & add upstream per-host dashboard". Will add steps and runbook notes.

Ryan K.: I'll adjust the alert thresholds and change the alerting query to use a 5m sliding window and evaluate using weighted sampling to avoid bursts from single noisy routes. I'll also add a runbook link to the alert.

Elaine M.: I'm going to raise circuit-breaker timeout from 3s -> 6s as a short-term change. Command applied: `infractl set-proxy-timeout --upstream model-hosting-eu --timeout 6s`.

infra-bot: Change applied by elaine.m — proxy timeout updated for model-hosting-eu.

Samir P.: after timeout bump + fallback routing we are back to ~0.8% 5xx. I'm slowly rolling down fallback to 25% to validate.

Elaine M.: thanks. I'm doing a handoff — my shift ends in 25m. Ryan, you'll pick up post-incident cleanup?

Ryan K.: happy to — pls drop links + current status.

Elaine M.: dropping links: metrics dashboard https://dash.redwood.ai/d/abc123/5xx-overview, log query `service:gateway status:5xx | json upstream_host, error_type | sort @timestamp desc | limit 50`, ops ticket OPS-1248. Current status: 5xx ~0.7%, traffic primary:80% fallback:20%, circuit-breaker timeout 6s.

Ryan K.: got it. I'll create the short post-incident checklist: 1) revert temporary muting, 2) finalize alert thresholds (2%/5m and >5% sustained), 3) add upstream per-host panel, 4) update runbook with fallback traffic commands, 5) schedule postmortem if we stay above baseline for next 2 hours.

Kate L.: can we also add an SLA impact calc in the postmortem? useful for customer comms.

Elaine M.: yes, adding to OPS-1248. Also tagging product-sre for comms if we need to notify enterprise customers.

pager-duty-bot: INC-2026 status -> mitigated (acknowledged by Ryan K.) :white_check_mark:

Ryan K.: closing incident for now; will keep monitoring for 2 hours and update OPS ticket with suggested alerting diffs and dashboard mockups. Thanks everyone — nice quick response.

Samir P.: good job. small followup: consider making the 1m noisy alert opt-in per-customer so internal noise doesn't wake the whole oncall rota.

Ryan K.: noted. added as a subtask in OPS-1248. Handoff complete.

Elaine M.: dropping final note before logout — recommend doing the thresholds change in staging first (OPS-PR-567) then to prod.

Ryan K.: will do.

Kate L.: 👍
